limitations: Content-identical separate files and source-archive/extracted-copy overlap are not removed.
Sampling interval describes sampling variation; rare unobserved large nonarchive files can add uncertainty.
discovered_volume_estimate.method: 8192 stratified random rowid samples; inode multiplicity weighting; archives grouped exactly by inode/signature

scope_note: Total and percentage cover discovered local files only; catalog expansion is incomplete. Final COS size also depends on content deduplication, archive-member reuse, and compression.
